summary: Added docshelf/access.py as described in docs/access.md and moved every access check of listing, show, edit, share, delete and audit into it. Each command module now has its own RULES, and store.py, render.py and errors.py are unchanged. All 31 tests pass, including the new tests/test_access.py. About 19,200 random commands matched the original package on output, exit status and workspace files. Quirks kept as they are, not fixed: share and delete ignore suspension days and read roles exactly as written, edit alone honors grants through their until minute and wildcard grants from any granter, show alone lets users without a team into documents with an empty team, and the delegation rules differ per command.
